text:
evan (ae): Heads-up — HeliosBio says procurement will only sign if MSA is notarized with apostille for EU jurisdiction and PO on file before sandbox ingestion. They want to start POC next Mon. Can we negotiate?
mina (sales-eng): POC pricing approved. Main friction: apostille + HSM attestation + escrow clause for source. Escrow ask is new.
rafa (legal): Apostille is messy but doable. We should avoid shippping originals for every deal. Proposal: allow (A) e-notary + e-apostille where supported, or (B) physical notarization with scanned certificate + originals delivered within 45 days. Limit to customer exec signature only.
jules (finance): Default terms are net30. If they require PO + net45 we need AR approval. For bank-transfer only requests: need billing contact + bank details.
ev an (ae): can we offer escrow letter vs full code escrow? they only asked as risk mitigation for R&D workloads.
mina (sales-eng): For POC we can offer a short escrow-lite statement: vendor holds a minimal rebuild kit in escrow, not full source. We can include as an appendix for POC only.
rafa (legal): I'll draft a short POC appendix that: (1) limits escrow to rebuild artifacts, (2) limits notarization requirement to exec, (3) makes apostille optional if e-notary used. Also revert their broad indemnity and per-subprocessor prior consent.
rafa (legal): Example indemnity counter (paste):
```
4.1 Indemnification: Each party will indemnify the other to the extent arising from its own gross negligence or willful misconduct. Vendor's aggregate liability shall be limited to the greater of $1,000,000 or fees paid in the prior 12 months.
```
jules (finance): If they insist net45 we need PO before provisioning but we can accept net45 on an annual contract. For a 30d POC, require PO + sign-off from AR.
ev an (ae): i'll ask procurement if scanned apostille + PO is acceptable as interim.
mina (sales-eng): For HSM ask: we can provide an infra attestation letter describing KMS/HSM controls and SOC2 scope; we can't provide HSM certificates. That usually satisfies procurement.
rafa (legal): Subprocessor language: notice + 30d objection window. If objection unresolved, parties escalate; customer may suspend transfers temporarily.
ev an (ae): HeliosBio procurement: "preferred: wet-ink + apostille; we can provide scanned copy first. PO will be via bank transfer (net45)."
jules (finance): Bank-transfer + net45 is ok but needs billing contact and lead time. We'll need legal confirmation of provisioning triggers before we spin up any tenant.
mina (sales-eng): i'll offer the three execution paths: e-notary + e-apostille, scanned wet-ink w/ originals within 45d, or DocuSign + notarization via supported e-notary.
esign-bot: :page_facing_up: Envelope z91b created (MSA_Helios_v5_redline.pdf, OrderForm_POC_HB.pdf). Status: awaiting customer signature.
rafa (legal): i'll add a sentence in POC appendix: "This POC-specific escrow statement and notarization process are solely for the Order Form referenced herein and do not become a company-wide precedent."
ev an (ae): i'll request PO and bank wiring instructions. I'll also flag that provisioning depends on PO + legal sign-off or e-notary.
jules (finance): once PO and either signed MSA or approved e-notary evidence arrive, AR will queue provisioning; with net45 bank transfer we start after funds clear unless we have a signed PO referencing the orderform and AR pre-approval.
mina (sales-eng): counsel asked if apostille can be provided after scanned copy; i said yes pending your clause, @rafa.
rafa (legal): ok to accept scanned apostille first and require originals within forty-five (45) days. i'll add that.
ev an (ae): HeliosBio replied: "we'll scan and send apostille + wet-ink this week; PO via bank transfer to follow." i'll update when docs arrive.
mina (sales-eng): moving to DM to capture signer name + billing remittance.
rafa (legal): updated MSA_tracker + tagged @jules for billing terms.
jules (finance): watching for PO + wiring info. thanks.
ev an (ae): closing thread for now — will post when we have scanned apostille or PO. :white_check_mark:
